messages:
carol: New POC ask from a defense contractor: fully air-gapped. They want options for physical media, offline activation, signed SBOM, and an upgrade cadence. Can someone own tech presales?

ben: I can. Quick clarifiers: preferred media (NVMe vs multiple USBs), single-file caps, and whether they require vendor HSM or customer keys?

ash: They prefer encrypted NVMe cartridges but will accept USBs. Hard cap on a single cartridge is ~256GB. Telemetry must be opt-out and disabled by default.

mohit: Ops: we recommend chunked signed bundles for anything >30GB. Resume logic supported. Example minimal manifest we ship:

```
manifest: v1
artifacts:
 - name: model-int8.bin
   parts: ["p1","p2"]
   sha256: abc123...
signed_by: redwood-release
```

ben: Signing modes: 1) customer-supplied keypair, 2) vendor HSM without escrow, 3) vendor HSM with escrow. All FIPS-compliant if required. HSM procurement adds lead time.

contracts-bot: Note: include export control and chain-of-custody clauses; liability for lost media must be defined.

carol: Customer asked for cadence: monthly security patches, feature updates every 3 months. Can we commit?

mohit: Yes: monthly security deltas, quarterly feature bundles. Caveat: quantized-delta builds often need a full rebuild; typical prep 24-72h depending on model size.

ash: If no GPUs provided, we will supply quantized (int8/GPTQ) variants. If we produce them, customer wants reproducible build logs and signed provenance.

ben: Ballpark for offline packaging + signing service + one-week on-site validation: $30k-$60k. Final quote after BOM.

carol: Action items: 1) I'll get BOM and media preference (ETA EOD). 2) @ben to confirm quantization acceptance with ML. 3) @mohit to run chunked-install smoke on staging and report. 4) Contracts to draft SOW addendum with acceptance checklist.

mohit: I'll run tests during staging window on Friday and post results.

contracts-bot: Reminder: add clause about key escrow procurement lead time and export-control review.

carol: Thanks team. I'll update buyer with three signing options and the price band, and attach SOW checklist. Keeping this thread as tracker.
